recommendations.reasoning: All documentation in this directory is from January 2025 or earlier and describes work that has been completed. The AI suggestion implementation guide is from a different worktree with different architecture. The three planning documents (final-features-design, final-features-implementation, retro-palm-pilot-redesign) are pre-implementation specifications for features confirmed complete in CLAUDE.md (Beta MVP Phases 1-5). The screenshots accompany the outdated worktree implementation. None of this documentation reflects current system state or provides value over the actual implemented codebase.
recommendations.consolidation_opportunity: Consider creating a single IMPLEMENTATION_HISTORY.md in root that summarizes the Beta MVP journey with key dates and decisions, then archive all detailed planning documents.
recommendations.empty_directories: Four empty subdirectories (ai/, dev/, .archive/, .updates/) suggest an abandoned organizational structure. Consider removing empty directories or populating with .gitkeep if structure is intended for future use.
